Policy Name: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)
Referred Sections: CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) with Decompression (Indirect or Direct)
Second or Greater Recurrent Disc Herniation (TOC: S7.1.6)

Required findings: Patient must be a candidate for repeat lumbar discectomy per CMM 606.3: Repeat Lumbar Microdiscectomy (Laminotomy or Laminectomy) at the Same Level.

Imaging must demonstrate evidence of anterolisthesis at the requested level(s) resulting in dynamic segmental instability on flexion-extension plain x-rays OR comparison of a supine and upright image with a translational alignment difference >3mm between views.
Imaging must demonstrate evidence of anterolisthesis at the requested level(s) resulting in Meyerding Grade II or higher spondylolisthesis.
Patient must be a never-smoker OR have refrained from smoking, use of smokeless tobacco products, and/or nicotine replacement therapy for at least six (6) weeks prior to planned surgery.
Nicotine-free status must be validated by objective cotinine testing methods (serum, urinary, or saliva) verified as within the normal range for the testing method and laboratory.
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) with Decompression (Indirect or Direct) > Recurrent Disc Herniation (TOC: S7.1.5)

Non-Indications: Absence of anterolisthesis with dynamic segmental instability (>3mm translational difference on flexion-extension or supine/upright imaging) or Meyerding Grade II or higher spondylolisthesis at the requested level(s).
Failure to meet candidate criteria for repeat lumbar discectomy per CMM 606.3.
Active smoking, use of smokeless tobacco, or nicotine replacement therapy within six (6) weeks prior to planned surgery.
Inability to provide objective cotinine testing (serum, urinary, or saliva) confirming nicotine-free status within normal laboratory ranges.
Second or greater recurrent disc herniation without meeting repeat discectomy candidate criteria or nicotine-free status requirements.
Important criteria & exceptions: Nicotine-free status is mandatory and must be objectively validated via cotinine testing (serum, urinary, or saliva) within normal lab ranges, or documented as a never-smoker.
Procedure requires the patient to first qualify as a candidate for repeat lumbar discectomy per CMM 606.3.

For second or greater recurrent disc herniations, fusion with decompression is indicated if the patient meets repeat discectomy criteria and nicotine-free status requirements, without additional specific imaging instability criteria listed in this section.
Documentation required: Flexion-extension plain x-rays or supine and upright comparison images demonstrating translational alignment measurements.
Advanced imaging reports (MRI/CT) confirming recurrent disc herniation and anterolisthesis with Meyerding grade classification.
Prior operative reports documenting previous lumbar discectomy at the same level.
Objective cotinine test results (serum, urinary, or saliva) with corresponding laboratory reference ranges confirming normal/negative status.
Provider clinical notes documenting smoking/nicotine history, abstinence duration, and functional impairment correlating with recurrent herniation.
